response.explanation: At line 22, src/presentation/server.ts imports `TextHiveClient` straight from the persistence layer (`../persistence/textHiveClient`). FF-S03 flags this because presentation should reach persistence only through the business layer. The same file already does that in other places: it imports `HiveService`, `ReportService`, `ScaleService` and `TreatmentService` from `../business` (lines 2-5), and `createServer` receives those services as parameters (lines 56-60). So the `TextHiveClient` import goes around that service boundary and ties the HTTP layer to a concrete storage client. The file also imports eight repository classes from `../persistence/repositories` (lines 12-21). That suggests either the file also wires up dependencies or the HTTP layer reaches into persistence more widely. The excerpt cuts off before showing how `TextHiveClient` is used, so I can't tell which. I had no project docs, ADRs or comments that address this dependency.
